Karem ne f Soabã yʋʋre, Soɑb ning sẽn naanã wã.
A naana ninsaal n yi zɩ-pelle.
Karem, tɩ fo Soabã n yɩɩd ne wɑoor lɑ kũuni.
Soɑb ningɑ Sẽn wilg gʋlsg ne kaal-moogã.
A wilga ninsaal bũmb ning a sẽn pa mi.
Ka woto ye, ad ninsaal yaa kεdgda ( ɑ mɑɑndɑme n zʋg toɑgɑ).
A sã n yã t'a seka a menga.
Ad lεbengã pata f Soabã nengẽ.
F yãɑ yel-solemd sẽn le yɩɩd ned ning (Abʋʋgεhl) sẽn gɩdgde.
Yambã (Mʋhɑmmɑd) t'a sã n wa pʋʋsdẽ?
Fo yãame sã n mikɑme t'ɑ sẽn gɩdgd-ɑ wã, sã n bee kãndgr zugu.
F yãame tɩ gɩdgdã sã n yagsame n gũd a zãn-kuidga.
Rẽ yĩnga a pa bãng tɩ Wẽnd nee ɑ sẽn tʋmdã?
Pa woto ye! Lak t'a sã n pa tek n bas, D na n veo-ɑ-la ne rĩirã zoobdo.
Pʋ-yagd sẽn yaa tudgd rĩir zoobdo.
Bɩ a bool a zĩ-zĩidsẽ rãmba (sõsd-n-tɑɑsã).
Tõnd na n boola Zɑbɑɑnyɑt ( Mɑlεg toose).
Pa woto ye! Ra tũ-a ye, la f tiuuli (maan suguudu) la f bao pẽnegr ne Wẽnde.
